decouvrir.hero_desc: From creating your account to the daily management of your group: what you get, how it works, and what changes depending on your plan.
decouvrir.step1_desc_before: Choose a plan, enter your group's name, your email and a password. Your account is created immediately, with
decouvrir.step1_desc_after: on the chosen plan — no payment required to get started.
decouvrir.step2_desc: Access your dashboard with your email and password. Forgot your password? A reset link is sent to you by email in one click.
decouvrir.step3_desc: Before the trial ends, pay your annual subscription via Wave, Orange Money, credit card or bank transfer, directly from your "My Subscription" area. You can also change plans at any time by paying only the difference.
decouvrir.warning_before: Without confirmed payment before the end of the 7-day trial, access to your workspace is automatically suspended
decouvrir.warning_after: until payment — your data remains intact, nothing is lost.
decouvrir.modules_desc: Each higher plan includes everything from the previous one, plus its own modules.
